CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  September 14, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 1221 North Hidalgo Avenue
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant Richard Gastelum was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given There were no written comments..

The applicant had no questions. He explained the basics of the design intention including working
with the existing ridge line. The style remains the same. The elevations facing Huntington and
Hidalgo contain some architectural elements.

Hernandez stated that she was accepting of the design but confirmed the extent of materials as it
related to the design. Tsai confirmed that the siding was new and not existing. Udani questioned
the color of the metal roof. The architect stated that the color was to be a grey.

Hernandez stated that if there was no materials board there should be a condition to that effect.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted with the condition that the
  applicant provide a color/materials board and specification be provided.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai.
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

  1
 Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2: 1605 South Ethel Avenue
APPLICANT:
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given. There were no public comments.

Hernandez, Daninger and Tsai had no comments and supported the design.

Udani concurred and called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:50
 •  Seconded by Stanley Tsai.
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
ATTEST:  Ankit Udani, Chairman

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
